ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: OnlyBudget uses the microphone while you speak an entry like "spent 12 on lunch". Your phone's speech recognizer turns it into text; OnlyBudget never records or stores audio.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: OnlyBudget uses speech recognition to turn what you say into a budget entry. Nothing is sent to us.
ios.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: OnlyBudget can use Face ID to unlock the app if you turn the app lock on.
